Ethosoft Competitions

Taking our work outside our own room.

A record of the competitions, conferences, and workshops where Ethosoft has presented its work, tested ideas under real constraints, and—starting with RoboCup Incheon—stepped onto an international stage. Full detail lives on each event's own page.

7 events 1 international competition More entries to follow

Why this record exists

From competitions to research culture.

Ethosoft's early period was shaped heavily by competitions and hackathons—see our full achievements record for photos and placements. Over time, the underlying question shifted from “can we build a good project?” to “how do we make this project scientifically stronger, measurable, and open to scrutiny?” The events on this page trace that shift, not just the results.

Competitions #01–#07

Every event, in order.

CompetitionTEKNOFEST · Health in AI

TEKNOFEST Sağlıkta Yapay Zekâ

Where Ethosoft's story really started: our first attempt to test freshly learned machine learning and deep learning on a real problem, at Türkiye's national AI-in-healthcare competition.

Organizer
TEKNOFEST
Result
3rd place in Türkiye

Why it matters: this is the competition Ethosoft names as the origin point of its work.

Hackathonİstinye University

DataMedX Hackathon

Generating an idea in a hackathon is one thing; turning it into a working system within a tightly limited timeframe is another. DataMedX, organized by İstinye University, tested exactly that.

Organizer
İstinye University
Result
Championship

Why it matters: an early test of building under real time pressure, not just designing on paper.

HackathonITU & Uyumsoft

MostrAI Hackathon

Is a strong model alone enough for an AI project? Ethosoft's view: no—technology also has to turn into a meaningful problem, a clear use case, a workable system, and real value for people.

Organizer
Istanbul Technical University & Uyumsoft
Result
Jury's Special Award

Why it matters: an early marker of judging a project by usefulness, not only technical strength.

HackathonEuropean Commission

EU Code Week Hackathon

A different competition, a different problem space, and another milestone: developing an idea quickly under the European Commission's EU Code Week hackathon program.

Organizer
European Commission
Result
1st place in Türkiye

Why it matters: Ethosoft's first national first-place result, under a European program.

HackathonMindBricks

MindBricks Hackathon

Another win in Ethosoft's hackathon journey—and also the period when our view of competitions itself began to change, as the first question we asked ourselves started to shift.

Organizer
MindBricks
Result
1st place

Why it matters: marks the point where Ethosoft started questioning what a hackathon win should actually mean.

CompetitionBaşakşehir Living Lab

Başakşehir Living Lab Innovation Competition

Can a technology project's success be measured by technical performance alone? Sometimes what matters is the value a solution delivers to users, its level of innovation, how workable it is, and its real-world counterpart.

Organizer
Başakşehir Living Lab
Result
2nd place in Türkiye

Why it matters: pushed Ethosoft to evaluate its own work by usability and real-world fit, not technical performance alone.

International competitionRoboCup · Incheon, South Korea

RoboCup — Incheon, South Korea

One of the most significant milestones in Ethosoft's journey: the point where our work moved outside Türkiye for the first time, presented in an international setting alongside researchers and technology teams from other countries.

Event
RoboCup, Incheon, South Korea
What changed
Technical communication, international perspective, and a stronger research culture around evaluation, assumptions, limitations, and documentation.

Why it matters: Ethosoft's first international presentation of its work, and a turning point from competition results toward research culture.
